svg.title: CGAgentX — corrected coarse-grained model diagrams
svg.desc: Original TOC artwork preserved as an embedded PNG. Editable vector overlays replace the solvent models with Figure 2 MS3 mappings: DMSO SUL–CGD2 with negative and positive dummy sites, respectively; DMA MOC–CGD2–CNI with negative dummy on MOC and positive dummy on CGD2. MXene is a single sheet three beads thick, with gold TiC2 core beads between mixed red TiOH and teal TiF surfaces. The atomistic MXene is projected from molecular_info/mxene.pdb, showing the Ti–C–Ti–C–Ti stack and OH/F terminations. CG surface composition is schematic. References: CGAgentX_manuscript (2).pdf, Figure 2 and section 3.2.1; MXene_Lammps_RE34/figures/drawing.svg.

g.title: Finite patch from mxene.pdb; Ti–C–Ti–C–Ti with OH/F terminations
DMSO MS3: SUL–CGD2 plus two charged dummy sites
DMA MS3: MOC–CGD2–CNI plus two charged dummy sites
TiOH/TiF surface — TiC2 core — TiOH/TiF surface
